MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The network switch feels like a useful next step after my Ethernet adapter and cables because it could let me connect more devices to the wired setup I am putting together.",
    "The mouse surface fits my keyboard accessories and desk organization purchases because it could help finish the workspace I already use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "A new PC case and internal power adapters assume I am rebuilding a computer, while my recent purchases mostly support connecting, organizing, and maintaining existing equipment.",
    "More headphones and another HDMI cable repeat functions I already have without an obvious new need; the headphone mount was about storing my headphones.",
    "The Galaxy S7 case depends on owning a specific phone I have not shown I own, and the optical cable and portable speaker do not address a connection or listening need I currently have.",
    "The WiFi adapter feels off because my recent Ethernet purchases point toward a wired connection rather than a need to add wireless access."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in computer accessories seems to have been stretched into an assumed need for almost any computer part.",
    "Past headphone and cable purchases seem to be treated as reasons to buy more of the same, even when a complementary accessory would make more sense."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchases form a connected project around wired networking, desk organization, and equipment upkeep; that shared purpose matters more than simply being electronics.",
    "Equipment I already have matters: a useful next purchase should fill a remaining need, fit my devices, or improve how I use them.",
    "My older Raspberry Pi and audio purchases do not necessarily describe what I need now, after the long gap before my recent networking and workspace purchases."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my desk and networking interests but often confuse completing my existing setup with buying loosely related electronics."
}
